snippet.title: Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity Trailer | The Game Awards 2025
snippet.description:
Whether you're jumping in for the first time and playing for free or adventuring in our recently launched sixth expansion, Visions of Eternity, the best time to play Guild Wars 2 is now! Join the millions of players in Tyria and experience the friendliest MMO community firsthand. 

In 2025, we celebrated 25 years of making games and 20 years since the launch of the original Guild Wars, which started it all. This would not be possible without the support of our incredible community. We're proud to celebrate our milestones with the Guild Wars players from around the world and are excited to be welcoming in thousands of players discovering our worlds for the very first time.

Play Guild Wars 2 now for free with no subscription ever:  https://welcome.guildwars2.com/

Buy Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity:  https://buy.guildwars2.com/en-us/visions-of-eternity

#guildwars2 #mmorpg #thegameawards
